title: Integration acceptance for the 1 December demo: scenarios, seeds and negative paths
status: design and seeds only (ruling 40720, 26 November 2026). The expected states are NOT computed: they wait for the Enrich engine build pinned after the ENR-28 fix (ruling 40719), whose moroku-enrich commit, version and dist SHA-256 go in enrich_build. If that build isn't pinned by Friday 27 November, Colin decides between the current build with ENR-28 disclosed and the seeded fallback. Committed before any candidate build; the architect freezes the expected results before the candidate is checked.
rulings: D57 to D60 (Decision Record page 3234988050): the demo order; seeded synthetic applicants through the real engines on Enrich path local; a hosted demo stage on synthetic or sandbox data only; this ticket
SIG-70 40719: the expected states use the Enrich build pinned after the ENR-28 fix
SIG-76 40720: prepare the scenarios' design and seeds and the negative paths now; compute no expected state until the build is pinned

data.set_v2_3_caveats: ADR 0010: salaried pay is identical to the cent; no sensitive merchants (the probe below adds them); drift scored per applicant; no cross-applicant code statistics

selection.method: ground truth only, never an engine's output; each rule takes the lowest applicant id that meets it
selection.bpay: No scenario has a liability repaid by BPAY, so no scenario's liabilities depend on the ENR-28 fix (BPAY bill payments returned as transfers by Enrich 1.7.0). BPAY bill payments for utilities and the like may still appear, and are affected by ENR-28 until the fixed build is pinned.

A.rule: regular salary, affordable: a CDR feed of 6 months or more; tags salaried-fixed and dishonour-clean and none of the risk tags; the salary account shared; every liability declared; no liability repaid by BPAY; truth surplus at or above the set's median
A.truth_summary: salaried-fixed; one declared loan (MONEY3, direct debit); 12 months; truth surplus 3775.86 a month

B.story: a hidden credit liability and affordability pressure
B.rule: a hidden credit liability and affordability pressure: a CDR feed of 6 months or more; tag salaried and none of the drift or gambling tags; the salary account shared; an undisclosed personal or car loan; no liability repaid by BPAY; truth surplus at or below the set's lower quartile
B.truth_summary: salaried, irregular, with overtime; one undisclosed personal loan (COMMBANK PL, direct debit); 6 months; truth surplus 238.59 a month

C.rule: missing income or insufficient evidence: a CDR feed of 3 months or more, tag salaried, no liability repaid by BPAY, whose salary account is not shared (EQ-01 then fails, and the assessment is unverified)
C.truth_summary: salaried-fixed; salary account not shared; 12 months

requests.recorded: 2026-11-27, before any expected state is computed (rulings 40730 and 40732; Colin's answers of 27 November: the proposed defaults, with the expense method observed)

sources.loan: proposed by engineering and accepted by Colin: a personal loan of $20,000 over 60 months at 11.5%, the same for every scenario so the scenarios differ only in their data
sources.policy: AF-T1's policy (test/fixtures/af-t1.json): buffer 3%, floor 5.5%, card commitment factor 0.03; shading is INC's default (src/engines/families/inc/config.ts, INC_DEFAULTS.shading)
sources.expense_method: observed (AF-E1, AF-E2): committed plus basic spending from the transactions, categorised on the pinned Enrich build. AF-E3's default needs confirmed expenses and a benchmark; the synthetic applications have no confirmed expenses and no seed benchmark rows exist, and X-2 never replaces a missing input, so every scenario would be unverified (Colin, 27 November)
sources.benchmark: none: the observed method doesn't read one
sources.as_of_and_lookback: set v2.3's as-of date (manifest) and the default 6-month lookback (D22)
sources.enrich: no Enrich tenant; the local path, forced (D58); the feed is synthetic, so it never goes to the API (D42)
sources.application: each applicant's own application from set v2.3 (stated gross income and declared liabilities), unchanged

negative_control.expect: the assessment is unverified, or evidence incomplete, with no guessed income figure. If it isn't, stop (SIG-76 T2)

perturbation.change: scenario A's most recent salary credit increased by $100.00, nothing else changed
perturbation.expect: the hosted result differs from scenario A's (SIG-76 T4: no hard-coded output)

negative_paths.expired_invite: an invite past its expiry: the applicant can't connect, and the lender sees it expired (T9)
negative_paths.revoked_grant: a grant revoked after connection: no new data is read, and the state shows revoked (T9)
negative_paths.cross_tenant_read: a tenant-B key reading tenant A's applicant and assessment gets 404 (T6, RLS)
negative_paths.billing_out_of_scope: billing (SIG-67) is not built: the over-limit and insufficient-balance invites are shown as out of scope, not tested
negative_paths.sensitive_probe: scenario A's applicant with added lines: a SACC narrative "IV<ZWSP>F NIMBLE REPAY" and card spend at "CARDIOLOGY CLINIC" with MCC 8011; no keyword or fragment shows anywhere, JSON, UI or PDF (T5)

procedure: on the hosted demo stage, at the candidate commit: a lender signs in, creates an applicant and sends an invite
the applicant completes the labelled sandbox consent
transactions are ingested and categorised by local Enrich, path recorded
the assessment completes, and its JSON (summary, affordability, signals and evidence) is fetched, with the PDF and webhook if in scope
each scenario is repeated three times from a clean state
the run record goes under research/runs/ with the commit, environment, set hash and versions (definitions, thresholds, taxonomy, keyword list, LIA, INC, EQ)
expected_states_when: computed by running the engines locally at the candidate commit, on the pinned Enrich build, for each scenario's roll-up, affordability ratios and key INC, LIA and EQ signals; frozen by the architect in a file with its SHA-256 recorded
out_of_scope: the real openfeed and live Enrich API paths
